import html from typing import List # Example template. In a real system this might be loaded from a config or file. USER_POST_FORMAT: str = """

{headline}

Posted by: {poster_name}

{text}
{tags}
""" def compose_post_html( poster_name: str, headline: str, text: str, hashtags: List[str] ) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- poster_name : str Name of the author. headline : str Post title. text : str Main body of the post. hashtags : List[str] Tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str The rendered HTML string. """ # Escape all user‑supplied content to prevent injection safe_poster = html.escape(poster_name, quote=True) safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=False) # Build tags string: each tag wrapped in and escaped safe_tags = [] for tag in hashtags: # Ensure the tag is a string; ignore non‑string entries if not isinstance(tag, str): continue escaped_tag = html.escape(tag.strip(), quote=True) safe_tags.append(f'{escaped_tag}') tags_html = " ".join(safe_tags) # Render the template rendered = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( poster_name=safe_poster, headline=safe_headline, text=safe_text, tags=tags_html ) return rendered.strip()
